lead.event: Ultrajaya approves dividend and rights issue for its planned Frisian Flag acquisition
lead.headline: ULTJ approves Rp14.57 trillion Frisian Flag acquisition, rights issue and dividend
lead.blurb: At its 6 November extraordinary meeting, Ultrajaya approved a rights issue authorization for up to 10 billion new shares with a nominal value of Rp50 each. The acquisition covers all 24,440 Frisian Flag Indonesia shares and will use an inbreng. FCIH is expected to become ULTJ’s controlling shareholder upon completion. Ultrajaya also approved an additional final cash dividend of Rp1.039 trillion, or Rp100 per share, payable on 9 December, with a recording date of 18 November.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from story to lead

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia shareholders approve a rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS shareholders approve rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia’s projected capital needs rise from Rp51.07 trillion in 2026 to Rp64.41 trillion in 2027. The new Series B shares have a nominal value of Rp500 each, while the final issue size and exercise price remain to be set by the board.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia's sustainability sukuk offering is oversubscribed 250%
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS sustainability sukuk offering is oversubscribed 250%
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia received Rp5.1 trillion in orders against a Rp2 trillion target by the offering period’s close on 6 November. The sukuk has one-, two- and three-year tenors with indicative yields of 7.00% to 7.20%, and proceeds will fund environmental and social activities.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Cakra Buana Resources Energi plans a rights issue for debt conversion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: CBRE plans rights issue of up to 48 billion shares for debt conversion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Cakra Buana’s planned issue has increased from 11.79 billion shares, with proceeds mainly set to convert Rp858.6 billion of promissory-note claims into paid-in capital. Remaining net proceeds are planned for working capital, and shareholders will vote on the plan at an extraordinary general meeting on 16 December.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: The planned rights issue increased from 11.79 billion shares to 48 billion shares.

deals_control.event: Garuda approves board changes and a rights issue with GMF AeroAsia shares
deals_control.headline: GIAA approves GMFI-linked rights issue of up to 248.7 billion shares and board changes
deals_control.blurb: The new Series E shares have a nominal value of Rp25 each, with GMFI shares contributed by Danantara Asset Management, a non-cash transfer that would return GMFI’s majority ownership to Garuda’s direct oversight. Garuda also appointed António José Vasconcelos Franco Gomes de Menezes as independent commissioner, replacing Trey Urbahn.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Garuda appointed António José Vasconcelos Franco Gomes de Menezes as independent commissioner, replacing Trey Urbahn.

deals_control.event: BP sells its 49.9% stake in Aneka Petroindo Raya to AKR Group
deals_control.headline: BP sells 49.9% APR stake to AKRA for US$14,221,500
deals_control.blurb: The transaction marks BP’s exit from fuel retail in Indonesia. AKR Corporindo subsidiaries AKRIDA and ADH acquired 11,444,565 shares, taking the group’s ownership of Aneka Petroindo Raya to 100% on 6 November.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The transaction marks BP’s exit from fuel retail in Indonesia.

deals_control.event: Rukun Raharja acquires 90% of Kapalindo Nusantara Jaya
deals_control.headline: RAJA acquires 90% of Kapalindo Nusantara Jaya
deals_control.blurb: The shares were bought through subsidiary Banawa Rezeki Optima from Abdul Rahmad Bahmid and Aqib Bachmid on 4 November 2026, with the price undisclosed. The deal gives Rukun Raharja control of Kapalindo Nusantara Jaya. The company holds a 25% stake in Golden Prima Maritim, which owns one LNG carrier and one Very Large Gas Carrier.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI reports nine-month 2026 profit growth and operating performance
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI reports 16.8% nine-month profit growth to Rp48.16 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI's subsidiary profit rose 43.5% to Rp11.8 trillion, equal to 24.4% of consolidated profit, Vice President Director Viviana Dyah Ayu said. Loans and financing grew 14.5% to Rp1,647 trillion, while third-party funds rose 12% to Rp1,651 trillion.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: Profit at BRI’s subsidiaries rose 43.5% to Rp11.8 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: BMRI reports October 2026 earnings and net interest margin
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports October profit of Rp4.6 trillion as NIM falls to 3.7%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Loans grew 16.45% year-on-year to Rp1,635 trillion. January–October net profit reached Rp46.52 trillion, up 19.64%, while cumulative NIM was 4%, below management’s 4.43% target. BRI Danareksa said the 92.8% loan-to-deposit ratio keeps margin pressure ongoing through year-end.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports nine-month 2026 profit growth among jumbo banks
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI leads jumbo banks with 20.7% nine-month profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s bank-only net profit reached Rp45.5 trillion by September, alongside 16% loan growth to Rp1,605.83 trillion and 17.7% third-party funds growth to Rp1,750 trillion. Analysts expect profit growth to moderate in Q4 as funding costs pressure margins.

earnings_guidance.event: EMAS targets higher ore stacking at the Pani Gold Mine
earnings_guidance.headline: EMAS targets 11 million tons of ore stacking at Pani in 2027
earnings_guidance.blurb: Merdeka Gold Resources President Director Boyke P. Abidin said the mine has consistently exceeded plan since September 2026. The higher target is intended to support gold production of 165,000 to 180,000 ounces in 2027, up from 85,000 to 100,000 ounces in 2026. The plans remain subject to approvals, final geotechnical confirmation and sustained operational performance.
